observer: Evaluator-supplied episode and logical tool-call windows, destination plus measured bidirectional TLS socket bytes; no physical timing claim. Includes wrong and failed executions. Model link is not the attack target in M3.
planner: LangGraph with genuine model decisions for check order, action, object, recovery and finish. State-based admissibility enforces required checks but never supplies the correct business action or object.
population: Synthetic PR retail fixtures, six action labels, 1–3 prerequisite checks. Fixture holdout, not unseen-template or deployment transfer.
reference_differences: PR MemoryBIO replay retained unchanged; LLM extension uses actual sockets and MCP.
MCP uses a common /mcp path, so the original HTTP path-length read-cover artifact is not assumed to recur.
One model seed per paired fixture; 120 train + 60 validation + 120 test per model/arm, rather than two oracle seeds.
Model decides finish and may recover; real calls beyond the reference plan are recorded.
schedule: Random 1–2 decoys; positions fixed before collection among slots after the ticket and after the first n_checks+1 honest calls. Further planner calls do not generate extra cover.
transport: Seven destination-mapped loopback MCP Streamable HTTP services over actual TLS 1.3 / HTTP/2 sockets; fixed 4096-byte JSON request and 16384-byte SSE response body quanta. Service destinations visible; plaintext hidden.
unknown_policy: Journal every model/tool request before dispatch. No automatic retry after a request without a terminal. Preserve partial episodes and abort the affected collection for audit; never replace, count as failure, or silently drop unknowns.
visible_control: Same isolated-state writes and schedule. Only isolated_visible forwards clearly marked gateway-cover request/response objects to the planner. They are not fabricated planner tool calls.
